paragraphs: Teekay Corporation Ltd. (or Teekay) is a leading provider of international crude oil marine transportation and other marine services. Teekay currently provides these services through its controlling ownership interest in Teekay Tankers Ltd. (NYSE: TNK) (or Teekay Tankers), one of the world's leading owners and operators of mid-sized crude tankers.

The consolidated Teekay entities manage and operate approximately 54 conventional tankers and other marine assets, including vessels operated for the Australian government. With offices in eight countries and approximately 2,130 seagoing and shore-based employees, Teekay provides a comprehensive set of marine services to the world's leading energy companies.
Our organizational structure can be divided into (a) our controlling interest in Teekay Tankers and (b) Teekay and its remaining subsidiaries (or Teekay Parent).

At March 1, 2026, we have an economic ownership interest of 30.7% in Teekay Tankers and hold 54.8% of the voting power of Teekay Tankers, through our ownership of Teekay Tankers' Class A and Class B common shares. Teekay Tankers includes all of our conventional crude oil and product tankers. Teekay Tankers' conventional tankers primarily operate in the spot tanker market or are subject to time charters or contracts of affreightment that are priced on a spot market basis. We consider contracts that have an original term of less than one year in duration to be short-term. Teekay Tankers also owns a ship-to-ship (or STS) transfer business that performs full service lightering and lightering support operations in the U.S. Gulf and Caribbean, and also has direct business operations in Australia through which it provides operational and maintenance marine services to the Australian Government and Australian energy companies. Please read "– B. Business Overview – Our Fleet" and "– C. Organizational Structure".

Following the maturity of Teekay's convertible senior notes in January 2023 (or the Convertible Notes), Teekay Parent repaid all of its debt and is now debt free. As at December 31, 2025 Teekay Parent has a cash and short-term investments position of approximately $120 million. Teekay Parent no longer has direct interests in any vessels or related equipment of any related management companies, and no longer employs seagoing staff or shore-based personnel. Please read "– B. Business Overview – Marine Services".

Teekay has developed extensive industry experience and industry-leading capabilities over its 50-plus-year history, and has increased its financial strength and liquidity following the strong tanker market over the past three years. Our primary financial objective for Teekay Parent is to increase Teekay's intrinsic value per share, which includes, among other things, increasing the intrinsic value of Teekay Tankers.

The Teekay organization was founded in 1973. We are a Bermuda exempted company and maintain our principal executive office at 2nd Floor, Swan Building, 26 Victoria Street, Hamilton, HM 12, Bermuda. Our telephone number at such address is (441) 298-2530.

The SEC maintains an internet site at www.sec.gov, that contains reports, proxy and information statements, and other information regarding issuers that file electronically with the SEC. Our website is www.teekay.com. The information contained on our website is not part of this Annual Report.
Our primary business is to own and operate crude oil tankers, product tankers, and other marine investments which we achieve through our controlling shareholding in Teekay Tankers.

We have two primary lines of business: (1) tankers and (2) marine services and our segments are presented on this basis. We allocate capital and assess performance from the perspective of the lines of business.

headings: Risk Factors
Risk Factor Summary
Risks Related to Our Industry
Changes in the oil markets could result in decreased demand for our vessels and services.
The cyclical nature of the tanker industry may lead to volatile changes in charter rates and significant fluctuations in the utilization of our vessels, which may adversely affect our earnings.
Changes in the spot tanker market may result in significant fluctuations in the utilization of our vessels and our profitability.
Our vessels operate in the highly competitive international tanker market.
High oil prices could negatively impact tanker freight rates.
Terrorist attacks, increased hostilities, political change or war could lead to further economic instability, increased costs and business disruption.
Acts of piracy on ocean-going vessels continue to be a risk, which could adversely affect our business.
Public health threats, including pandemics, epidemics and other public health crises, could have an adverse effect on our operations and financial results.
Governments could requisition our vessels during a period of war or emergency, which may adversely affect our business and results of operations.
Risks Related to Our Business
Economic downturns, including disruptions in the global credit markets, could adversely affect our ability to grow.
Economic downturns may affect our customers' ability to charter our vessels and pay for our services and may adversely affect our business and results of operations.
We may not be able to grow or to manage our growth effectively.
An increase in operating costs, due to increased inflation or otherwise, could adversely affect our cash flows and financial condition.
The timing of dry dockings of our vessels during peak market conditions could adversely affect our profitability.
Delays in the delivery of and installation of new vessel equipment could result in significant vessel off hire and have adverse impacts on our results of operations.
Technological innovation could reduce our charter hire income and the value and operational lives of our vessels.

Over time, the value of our vessels may decline, which could adversely affect our existing loan and other financial obligations we may incur in the future, our ability to obtain new financing or our operating results.

The ability of Teekay Parent's subsidiaries to distribute funds to Teekay Parent is a significant factor in its capacity to meet its financial obligations and to fund any dividend payments or share repurchases.
Financing agreements containing operating and financial restrictions may restrict our business and financing activities.

Teekay Tankers' revolving credit facility and any future financing agreements may limit our flexibility in obtaining additional financing, pursuing other business opportunities, paying dividends and repurchasing shares.

Many of our seafaring employees are covered by collective bargaining agreements and the failure to renew those agreements or any future labor agreements may disrupt operations and adversely affect our cash flows.
We may be unable to attract and retain qualified, skilled employees or crew necessary to operate our business, and the cost of attracting and retaining such personnel may increase.
Our insurance may be insufficient to cover losses that may occur to our vessels or result from our operations.
Maritime claimants could arrest, or port authorities could detain, our vessels, which could interrupt our cash flow from these vessels.

In addition, please refer to Item 5 in our Annual Report on Form 20-F for the year ended December 31, 2024 for our discussion and analysis comparing our financial condition and results of operations from 2024 to 2023.

Teekay Corporation Ltd. (or Teekay) is a leading provider of international crude oil and other marine transportation services. Teekay provides these services through its controlling ownership interest in Teekay Tankers Ltd. (NYSE: TNK) (or Teekay Tankers), a leading owner and operator of mid-sized crude oil and product tankers. Teekay and its current subsidiaries, other than Teekay Tankers, are referred to herein as "Teekay Parent".

As of December 31, 2025, Teekay Parent had an economic interest of 30.8% and voting power of 54.9% in Teekay Tankers. Since Teekay Parent controls the voting interests of Teekay Tankers through its ownership of Class A and Class B common shares of Teekay Tankers, we consolidate the results of this subsidiary.

We formed Teekay Tankers in 2007. Teekay Tankers holds all of our oil and product tanker assets, primarily consisting of Suezmax and Aframax / LR2 tankers, and engages in short to medium-term fixed-rate charter contracts and spot tanker market trading. In addition, Teekay Tankers also owns a Very Large Crude Carrier (or VLCC) tanker (which is under contract to be sold), a ship-to-ship transfer business that performs full service lightering and lightering support operations in the U.S. Gulf and Caribbean, and operations in Australia that provide operational and maintenance marine services provided to the Australian government, Australian energy companies and other third parties.

The assets of Teekay Parent consist of Teekay Parent's controlling interest in publicly-listed Teekay Tankers, and a cash and short-term investments position of $120.2 million as at December 31, 2025. Our primary financial objective for Teekay Parent is to increase Teekay's intrinsic value per share, which includes, among other things, increasing the intrinsic value of Teekay Tankers.

Teekay has developed extensive industry experience and industry-leading capabilities over its 50-plus-year history. We believe our controlling interest in Teekay Tankers and its operating platform, together with both Teekay and Teekay Tankers' strong balance sheets, positions us well to pursue investments both in crude oil and product transportation and broader shipping markets where we can leverage our operating franchise and the proven capabilities of the Teekay platform to create long-term shareholder value.
For additional information about Teekay Tankers, please refer to Teekay Tankers' Annual Report on Form 20-F for the year ended December 31, 2025, as filed with the SEC.

During 2025, the U.S. administration and other governments have announced or taken actions to implement new or increased tariffs on foreign imports and port fees. These actions have resulted and may result in additional retaliatory tariffs being levied on various goods and commodities, which may trigger trade wars. Additionally, in early 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court struck certain of the tariffs implemented by the U.S. administration, who thereafter reimplemented certain tariffs in response, which may cause additional uncertainty and increase geopolitical tensions. These activities have disrupted global markets, resulting in an increase in general global economic uncertainty, including an increased risk of economic recessions. In 2025, the U.S. and China also announced new port fees that would apply to port calls of certain Chinese and U.S.-related tankers, respectively, which could be disruptive to our industry. These port fees subsequently have been suspended until October 2026. As a result of the rapidly changing and unpredictable geopolitical climate, the shipping industry is experiencing uncertainty as to future vessel demand, trade routes, rates and operating costs.

Geopolitical conflicts and related sanctions, export controls and price caps have significantly affected us and our industry, including by disrupting energy supply chains and trading patterns, and causing instability and volatility in the global economy. These conflicts include, among others, Russia's ongoing invasion of Ukraine, Houthi rebel attacks on vessels in the Red Sea area, and the recent U.S., Israel and Iran conflict and related severe disruptions to voyages through the Strait of Hormuz. U.S. action in Venezuela during 2026, including the removal of President Nicolás Maduro and greater involvement in Venezuelan oil production and exports, has led to a collapse in crude oil flows to China via the "dark fleet" and shifted trade towards the compliant fleet of tankers. This development could benefit mid-size tankers in particular should more Venezuelan oil be sold to U.S. and European markets. The escalation and expansion of hostilities in the Middle East, and the possibility of continuing instability or further escalation in Ukraine, Venezuela or elsewhere could continue to affect the price of crude oil and the oil industry, the tanker industry and demand for our services.

During 2025, Teekay Tankers sold eight 2006 to 2009-built Suezmax tankers and three 2006 to 2007-built Aframax / LR2 tankers for a total price of $341.0 million, which resulted in an aggregate gain on sales of $100.5 million during 2025. All of these tankers were delivered to their purchasers during 2025.

In December 2025, Teekay Tankers entered into an agreement to sell one 2007-built Suezmax tanker for $33.0 million. The tanker and its related bunker and lube oil inventories were classified as held for sale as at December 31, 2025. The tanker was delivered to the purchaser during January 2026.

In January 2026 and February 2026, Teekay Tankers entered into agreements to sell one 2009-built Suezmax tanker and one 2013-built VLCC tanker for a combined sales price of $124.5 million. The Suezmax tanker was delivered to its purchaser during March 2026, and the VLCC tanker is expected to be delivered to its purchaser during the second quarter of 2026.
In May 2025, Teekay Tankers completed the purchase of one 2019-bulit Aframax / LR2 tanker for a purchase price of $63.0 million.

paragraphs: Teekay Corporation Ltd. (或 Teekay) 是國際原油海運及其它海事服務的主要提供者。Teekay 目前透過其控制性股權投資於 Teekay Tankers Ltd. (NYSE: TNK) (或 Teekay Tankers)，一家全球領先的中型原油運輸船隊擁有及營運公司，提供這些服務。
合併後的 Teekay 企業管理及營運約 54 艘傳統油輪及其他海事資產，包括為澳洲政府運營的船舶。擁有八個國家的辦事處及約 2,130 名海上及岸上員工，Teekay 向全球領先的能源公司提供全面的海事服務。
我們的組織架構可分為 (a) 我們對 Teekay Tankers 的控制性股權，以及 (b) Teekay 及其餘下子公司 (或 Teekay Parent)。

截至 2026 年 3 月 1 日，我們持有 Teekay Tankers 30.7% 的經濟權益，並透過擁有 Teekay Tankers 的 A 股及 B 股普通股，持有其 54.8% 的投票權。Teekay Tankers 包含我們所有的傳統原油及產品油輪。Teekay Tankers 的傳統油輪主要在現貨油輪市場運營，或受時間租賃或租賃合約約束，這些合約以現貨市場價格為基礎。我們將原始合同期限少於一年的合約視為短期合約。Teekay Tankers 還擁有船舶對船舶 (或 STS) 轉移業務，執行美國墨西哥灣及加勒比海地區的完整服務輕載及輕載支援作業，並在澳洲有直接業務運營，為澳洲政府及澳洲能源公司提供運營及維護海事服務。請閱讀 "– B. 事業概覽 – 我們的船隊" 及 "– C. 組織架構"。

在 Teekay 的可轉換優先債券於 2023 年 1 月到期 (或稱為可轉換債券) 後，Teekay Parent 已償還所有債務，現已無債務。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Teekay Parent 持有約 120 百萬美元的現金及短期投資。Teekay Parent 現已不再對任何相關管理公司的船舶或相關設備擁有直接權益，也不再僱用任何海上員工或岸上人員。請閱讀 "– B. 事業概覽 – 海事服務"。
Teekay 在其 50 多年的歷史中已發展出廣泛的產業經驗及產業領先能力，並在過去三年強勁的油輪市場中增強了財務實力及流動性。我們對 Teekay Parent 的主要財務目標是提高 Teekay 每股內在價值，其中包括提高 Teekay Tankers 的內在價值。
Teekay 組織於 1973 年成立。我們是註冊於百慕達的豁免公司，主要營業據點位於百慕達漢密爾頓市維多利亞街 26 號 Swan 建築物 2 樓，電話號碼為 (441) 298-2530。

本公司主要業務為擁有並營運原油運輸船、產品運輸船及其他海運投資，此業務透過本公司對 Teekay Tankers 的控制性股權實現。
我們有兩大主要業務線：(1) 運輸船及 (2) 海運服務，並依此基礎劃分應報告分部。我們從業務線的觀點來配置資本並評估績效。

Teekay Corporation Ltd.（或 Teekay）為國際原油及其他海運服務之領導供應商。Teekay 透過其對 Teekay Tankers Ltd.（紐約證券交易所：TNK）（或 Teekay Tankers）之控制性股權提供這些服務，Teekay Tankers 為中型原油及產品油輪之領導所有者與營運者。Teekay 及其現有子公司（除 Teekay Tankers 除外）於本文件中稱為 "Teekay Parent"。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Teekay Parent 在 Teekay Tankers 持有經濟權益 30.8% 及投票權 54.9%。由於 Teekay Parent 透過持有 Teekay Tankers 之 Class A 及 Class B 普通股控制 Teekay Tankers 之投票權，因此我們將此子公司之結果合併入財務報表。

我們於 2007 年成立 Teekay Tankers。Teekay Tankers 持有我們所有油輪及產品油輪資產，主要為蘇伊士型及阿芙拉型 / LR2 油輪，並從事短至中長期固定租賃合約及散裝油輪市場交易。此外，Teekay Tankers 還擁有 一 艘非常大型原油運輸船（VLCC）（目前正與買方簽訂出售合約），一艘船對船轉運業務，於美國墨西哥灣及加勒比海執行完整服務輕載及輕載支援作業，以及於澳洲提供澳洲政府、澳洲能源公司及其他第三方之運營及維護海事服務。
Teekay Parent 之資產包括 Teekay Parent 對公開上市之 Teekay Tankers 之控制性股權，以及截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日之現金及短期投資金額為 120.2 百萬美元。我們對 Teekay Parent 之主要財務目標為提高 Teekay 之每股內在價值，其中包括提高 Teekay Tankers 之內在價值。
Teekay 在其 50 年以上之歷史中已發展出廣泛之產業經驗及產業領先之能力。我們相信，我們對 Teekay Tankers 之控制性股權及其營運平台，加上 Teekay 及 Teekay Tankers 之強大資產負債表，使我們在原油及產品運輸及更廣泛之海運市場中，能有效進行投資，並利用我們之營運品牌及 Teekay 平台之已證實能力，創造長期股東價值。
如需更多關於 Teekay Tankers 之資訊，請參閱 Teekay Tankers 之 Form 20-F 年度報告，該報告為 2025 年 12 月 31 日結算年度所提交，並已向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交。

2025 年，美國政府及其他政府已宣佈或採取行動，實施針對外國進口商品的新或提高的關稅與港口費用。這些行動已導致並可能導致針對各種商品與商品的額外報復性關稅被課徵，這可能引發貿易戰。此外，在 2026 年初，美國最高法院廢除了美國政府所實施的某些關稅，隨後美國政府重新實施了某些關稅，這可能導致額外的不確定性並增加地緣政治緊張。這些活動已幹擾全球市場，導致一般全球經濟不確定性增加，包括增加經濟衰退的風險。2025 年，美國與中國也宣佈了新的港口費用，適用於特定中國與美國相關油輪的港口靠泊，這可能對我們的產業造成幹擾。這些港口費用隨後已暫停至 2026 年 10 月。由於地緣政治氣候快速變動且難以預測，船運產業正面臨未來船舶需求、貿易路線、費用與營運成本的不確定性。

地緣政治衝突及相關制裁、出口管制與價格上限已對我們與我們產業造成重大影響，包括幹擾能源供應鏈與交易模式，並導致全球經濟的不穩定與波動。這些衝突包括，但不限於俄羅斯對烏克蘭的持續入侵、紅海地區胡塞叛亂組織對船舶的攻擊，以及最近美國、以色列與伊朗的衝突及相關對霍爾木茲海峽航運的嚴重幹擾。2026 年美國在委內瑞拉的行動，包括移除尼古拉斯·馬杜羅總統與在委內瑞拉石油生產與出口方面更積極的參與，導致透過「暗 fleet」向中國的原油流動崩潰，並轉向符合規範的油輪船隊進行貿易。此發展若更多委內瑞拉石油銷售至美國與歐洲市場，可能特別有利於中型油輪。中東地區衝突的升級與擴張，以及烏克蘭、委內瑞拉或其他地區持續不穩定或進一步升級的可能性，可能繼續影響原油價格與石油產業、油輪產業及對我們服務的需求。
2025 年，Teekay Tankers 售出八艘 2006 至 2009 年建造的蘇伊士型油輪與三艘 2006 至 2007 年建造的阿弗拉型 / LR2 油輪，總價為 341.0 百萬美元，導致 2025 年銷售總計獲利 100.5 百萬美元。這些油輪均於 2025 年交付給買方。
2025 年 12 月，Teekay Tankers 與買方簽訂協議，出售一艘 2007 年建造的蘇伊士型油輪，價格為 33.0 百萬美元。該油輪及其相關燃料與潤滑油存貨於 2025 年 12 月 31 日被歸類為待售資產。該油輪於 2026 年 1 月交付給買方。
2026 年 1 月與 2 月，Teekay Tankers 與買方簽訂協議，出售一艘 2009 年建造的蘇伊士型油輪與一艘 2013 年建造的超大型油輪，總銷售價格為 124.5 百萬美元。蘇伊士型油輪於 2026 年 3 月交付給買方，超大型油輪預計於 2026 年第二季交付給買方。
2025 年 5 月，Teekay Tankers 完成購入一艘 2019 年建造的阿弗拉型 / LR2 油輪，購入價格為 63.0 百萬美元。

headings: 風險因素
風險因素總覽
與我們產業相關的風險
油價市場的變化可能導致對我們船舶及服務的需求減少。
散裝船運輸產業的週期性特質可能導致租賃費率出現波動，並造成我們船舶使用率的重大變動，這可能會對我們的獲利產生不利影響。
散裝船市場的變化可能導致我們船舶使用率及盈利能力出現重大波動。
我們的船舶運作於高度競爭的國際散裝船市場。
高油價可能對散裝船運費產生負面影響。
恐怖攻擊、增加的敵對行動、政治變動或戰爭可能導致進一步的經濟不穩定、成本增加及業務中斷。
對海上船隻的盜賊行為持續為風險，可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
公共衛生威脅，包括大流行、傳染病及其他公共衛生危機，可能對本公司運作及財務結果產生不利影響。
政府可能在戰爭或緊急時期徵用本公司船隻，可能對本公司業務及運作結果產生不利影響。
與本公司業務相關的風險
經濟衰退，包括全球信貸市場的中斷，可能對本公司擴張能力產生不利影響。
經濟衰退可能影響客戶租用本公司船隻及支付服務費用的能力，並可能對本公司業務及運作結果產生不利影響。
本公司可能無法擴張或有效管理擴張。
營運成本增加，由於通貨膨脹上升或其他因素，可能對我們的現金流量與財務狀況造成不利影響。
在市場高峯時期，船舶進廠檢修的時間點可能對我們的獲利能力造成不利影響。
新船舶設備交付與安裝的延誤，可能導致船舶停租，並對我們的營運結果產生不利影響。
科技創新可能降低我們的租賃收入，並降低船舶的價值與使用壽命。
隨著時間經過，我們的船舶價值可能下降，這可能對我們現有的貸款及其他未來可能產生的財務義務造成不利影響，也可能影響我們取得新融資的能力或營運結果。
Teekay Parent 的子公司將資金分派給 Teekay Parent 的能力，是其履行財務義務及支付股息或回購股份的重要因素。
包含營運與財務限制條款的融資協議，可能限制我們的營運與融資活動。
Teekay Tankers 的循環信貸協議及未來可能的融資協議，可能限制我們取得額外融資、追求其他營運機會、支付股息及回購股份的靈活性。
許多從事海上運輸的員工受集體談判協議所保障，若未能續約這些協議或任何未來的勞動協議，可能會干擾營運並不利於我們的現金流。
我們可能無法吸引並留住合資格且具專業技能的員工或船員，以執行我們的業務，且吸引及留住這些人員的成本可能增加。
我們的保險可能不足以賠償船舶損失或營運所導致的損失。
海事聲請人可能扣押，或港口當局可能扣留，我們的船舶，這可能會干擾這些船舶的現金流。
paragraphs: 部分風險摘要於下文並在後續頁面中更詳細討論，主要與我們所從事的產業及我們業務的總體情況有關。其他風險則主要與證券市場及持有我們普通股的權益有關。本節所描述的任何事件發生，都可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果及支付普通股股息的能力，以及普通股的交易價格產生重大且不利的影響。
•油價市場的變化可能導致我們船舶及服務的需求減少。
•油輪產業的週期性特質可能導致租賃費率出現波動，並使我們船舶的利用率產生顯著變動，這可能對我們的獲利產生不利影響。
•散裝油輪市場的變化可能導致我們船舶的利用率及盈利能力產生顯著變動。
•我們的船舶在高度競爭的國際油輪市場中運作。
•高油價可能對油輪運費產生負面影響。
